text: I'm a childminder and I've got a little boy here, he's 2. His temp's just come up at 37.8 and I'm really panicking because his mum is unreachable until later. He hasn't done a poo for three days now and he's been grumpy about it, pushing and moaning. He's wide awake though, chatting away and watching his cartoons, and when he dozed off earlier he woke up easily. I checked his neck because I always worry about that, and it's fine. He can look right down at his tummy and his toes. I just don't want to get this wrong with someone else's child.
